source.rationale: Probes corrector._locate_verbatim_span (Engineering Decision Log Entry 38) against a harder reformatting case than the original fix: the sentence needing correction lives inside a Markdown TABLE cell, not free prose. A model 'quoting' a table row commonly drops leading/trailing pipe characters or normalizes internal spacing around them -- a different failure mode than the line-wrap/em-dash case the tolerant regex was built for. NOT YET RUN against the real pipeline -- this is a designed probe, not a confirmed result. Expected pipeline outcome intentionally omits corrector_status/validator_status pending a real LLM_API_KEY run; only verifier_expected_stale is asserted as a hard gold label since that part is deterministic given the semantic change.

labels.notes_for_labeler: CONFIRMED (real run). Mechanical abstention did NOT reproduce: the corrector located and quoted the table row cleanly, validator approved. Negative result, same conclusion as case 004's original stress test — the tolerant locator (Entry 38) generalizes to Markdown table rows, not just wrapped prose. No new gap found here; keeping as a permanent regression case for this specific reformatting shape.
